name: james-ladder
description: James' Ladder: a harmonic sketchpad for chord progressions. Web app plus the Android (Capacitor) wrapper.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.icons: python icons/make_android_assets.py && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --assetPath assets
